note: [LLM critic, high conf] The AI charges a 1-wound enemy Prosecutor with an 8% chance, 10.2 in away, and the score is positive only because of flat bonuses. The real problem is that ch_chance (-11.81) is swamped by +3, +3, +2 and +1.9 flat terms, so a charge that almost never works looks good. Fix: Multiply every positive charge benefit term by charge_probability. Reject any option below charge_threshold before scoring. Also give a negative score to charges that need long moves through obscuring terrain. Compare against a 'do not charge' option that keeps the unit shooting and holding position.
suggestion: Prosecutor Squad declares charge against Prosecutor Squad (8% chance, 10.2" away, expected 0.7 melee dmg vs 1 HP, overwatch risk: 0.3 dmg)
